note: Performance measurements of TS 28.552 (Release 16, v16.20.0) that the core counts, with the metric each one is computed from. `fidelity` says where the count differs from the definition: `exact` means the event of the definition is the event counted; otherwise the text says how it differs. Measurements the core does not count are not listed (and not invented). The registration measurements also have their per-S-NSSAI subcounters (RM.RegInitReq.<snssai> and so on; the S-NSSAI is written `<sst>` or `<sst>-<sd as 6 hex digits>`, one count for each slice of the requested NSSAI at the request and of the allowed NSSAI at the accept, `none` when a request names no slice). The service request, paging, PDU session and GTP measurements have no subcounters.

measurements.name: RM.RegInitReq
measurements.fidelity: registration requests admitted by the overload check; no per-S-NSSAI subcounter

measurements.name: RM.RegInitSucc
measurements.fidelity: counted when the registration is complete (Registration Complete received), not at transmission of Registration Accept; no per-S-NSSAI subcounter

measurements.name: RM.RegisteredSubNbrMean
measurements.fidelity: mean of the samples taken during the period (--interval), not of a continuous measurement; no per-S-NSSAI subcounter

measurements.name: RM.RegisteredSubNbrMax
measurements.fidelity: maximum of the samples taken during the period; can miss a peak between two samples; no per-S-NSSAI subcounter

measurements.name: MM.ServiceReqTotalAtt
measurements.fidelity: service requests that were answered; the network-initiated ones (paging) are included only when the UE answers with a Service Request

measurements.name: MM.ServiceReqTotalSucc
measurements.fidelity: exact for the service requests counted above

measurements.name: MM.Paging5GReq
measurements.fidelity: every paging message sent is counted, so a procedure with retransmissions counts more than once

measurements.name: SM.PduSessionCreationReq
measurements.fidelity: Nsmf_PDUSession create requests that reached the SMF; no per-request-type subcounter

measurements.name: SM.PduSessionCreationSucc
measurements.fidelity: exact for the requests counted above; no per-S-NSSAI subcounter

measurements.name: GTP.InDataPktN3UPF
measurements.fidelity: packets the UPF accepted and forwarded from the access side (those it dropped are in g5c_upf_dropped_packets_total)

measurements.name: GTP.OutDataPktN3UPF
measurements.fidelity: packets sent towards the access side

measurements.name: GTP.InDataOctN3UPF
measurements.fidelity: octets of the forwarded packets as the UPF counts them; whether the GTP-U header is included is the UPF engine's rule, not the definition's
